name: sub-usage-push
description: Pushes the Claude subscription's 5-hour and 7-day rate-limit usage to an ai-plan-insight dashboard.

endpoint.title: Dashboard URL
endpoint.description: Base URL of the ai-plan-insight dashboard, e.g. https://dashboard.example.com.

instanceId.title: Instance ID
instanceId.description: The push instance's ID on the dashboard (type claude, mode push).

token.title: Push token
token.description: The dashboard's push_auth_secret, sent as a Bearer token.
